description: Abstract class defining multipart upload management for AWS SDK, including methods for initiating, executing, and completing uploads, with asynchronous promise handling.

classes.name: AbstractUploadManager
classes.description: Defines the structure and workflow for managing multipart uploads to AWS services, including state management, command execution, and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the upload manager with a client and configuration, setting up upload info and state.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Performs the upload synchronously, waiting for completion.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise for the upload operation, initiating it if not already started.

methods.name: transformException
methods.description: Converts exceptions into specific multipart upload exceptions.

methods.name: buildFailureCatch
methods.description: Builds a catch handler for promise rejections, compatible with Throwable or Exception.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Abstract method to load service-specific upload workflow info.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the size of upload parts.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Abstract method to process the result of an upload part.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Abstract method to get parameters for initiating upload.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Abstract method to get parameters for completing upload.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the current upload state based on config and info.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes a service command asynchronously with optional pre-processing.

methods.name: getResultHandler
methods.description: Creates a response handler for upload part results, managing success and errors.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Abstract method to generate upload part commands.
